messages:
Sanjay (Sales): FYI we got a request from Telos to run a joint 2-week POC. Key asks: SAML SSO, static egress for allowlists, a staging tenant, and a procurement-ready cost ballpark. Can we scope?
Monica (Partner Ops): I can handle tenant + entitlement. Need partner billing contact and a signed MSA/DPA or at least a PO. @telos-onboarding who is finance?
telos-onboarding (external): finance@telos.co for billing. They can provide a PO draft. We also attached telos_poc_sec_q1.xlsx.
Alex (Solutions Eng): Quick sizing questions: target concurrency? avg input/output tokens? preferred model family? seq len targets? These change whether we recommend hosted vs Dedicated.
Sanjay (Sales): Telos says 20-40 concurrent users. Typical prompt ~300 tokens in, ~200 tokens out. 1k-2k seq len tops. Preference for open models but willing to test Redwood variants.
Sarah (Security): From security: they need a completed security questionnaire, SOC2 summary, SAML metadata (entityID + cert), ability to allowlist static egress IPs or ranges, and 90d+ audit log retention. They asked about KMS/HSM support too.
Tim (Infra): For static egress there are two routes: 1) host in their VPC with customer-managed NAT (we provide connectors) or 2) provision Dedicated capacity with our static IP pool. Dedicated gives stronger SLO guarantees. Staging tenant can be in us-west1.
Alex (Solutions Eng): My recommended minimal POC config: - Dedicated small pool (2x A10s equivalent) - Model candidates: open-llama-13B-8bit or redwood-medium-quant - Enable KV prefix caching and token window ~2048 - Canary fallback to hosted smaller variant if saturation
Alex (Solutions Eng): Sample load test curl for smoke:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"open-llama-13B-8bit","input":"Explain X in 3 bullets","max_tokens":200}'
```
Monica (Partner Ops): I've created a staging tenant stub: id=st-telos-poc-2255 region=us-west1. will fully provision once DPA/MSA or PO confirmed.
OpsBot: Tenant provisioning: st-telos-poc-2255 created (region=us-west1) by @Monica. status=provisioning
Sarah (Security): I'll take the questionnaire. Please share telos_poc_sec_q1.xlsx and SAML metadata. I can produce SOC2 excerpt and KMS integration notes.
Tim (Infra): If Telos needs single static IP per egress, recommend Dedicated + NAT gateway. If ranges ok we can provide a /24. I'll draft the infra checklist (firewalls, routing, certs, monitoring hooks).
Sanjay (Sales): They need a procurement number for 100k generated tokens/day and 30 conc with 99.95 SLO. Hosted vs Dedicated estimate please.
Alex (Solutions Eng): Back-of-envelope: 100k gen tokens/day ~ 3M gen tokens/mo. Hosted (open models, quantized) ~ $7k-$14k/mo depending on model. Dedicated reserved pool with static egress & SLO ~ $18k-$28k/mo. Mark as estimates. Will add assumptions in doc.
Monica (Partner Ops): Owners: @Monica = tenant & billing; @Alex = runbook + perf tests + model recommendation; @Sarah = security Q&A + certs; @Tim = infra checklist + egress plan. I'll collect SAML metadata and test user list by EOD tomorrow.
telos-onboarding (external): we can provide SAML metadata today and a 5-user test group. Procurement is time-sensitive.
Sarah (Security): A few clarifications: what exact audit retention is required (90d minimum?) and any data residency constraints? We'll prioritize SOC2 excerpt and KMS notes.
Sanjay (Sales): Telos confirmed 90d log retention and prefer US-only hosting for now.
Tim (Infra): Noted. US-west1 Dedicated is fine. I'll post the checklist link when ready.
Alex (Solutions Eng): I'll include in the runbook: - traffic shaping script for canary - sample load generator - acceptance criteria (latency p95, token throughput, no auth failures) - rollback plan.
Monica (Partner Ops): I'll chase the PO + signed DPA. If we can commit to static IP plan + DPA in 3 business days they said they'll sign.
OpsBot: Deployment update: st-telos-poc-2255 status=ready.
Sanjay (Sales): Great. Ping me when runbook + cost sheet + security answers are in this thread. Thanks team! :rocket:
